versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to functionality or documentation beyond this file removal.

- Clarified which iAqualink features have been tested live versus those still inferred or unverified.
- Updated notes to specify that iAqua sign-in, system listing, status reads, and WebTouch panel tools have been seen working on real hardware.
- Added cautions around the unverified status of iAqua set commands, all eXO support, and the chlorinator request shape.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Added support for schedules/timers and OneTouch scenes on iAqualink systems.
- New tools to list, add, edit, and delete schedules for Jandy AquaLink RS panels; and set timers for eXO systems.
- OneTouch scene control is now available (list/start/stop scenes).
- Documentation updated to include all new features and troubleshooting guidance.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

Initial release: Adds iAqualink pool and spa control via iaqualink-mcp tools.

- Check and control pool/spa equipment, temperatures, lights, chlorinator output, and chemistry.
- Supports both iAqua (Jandy iAquaLink) and eXO (Zodiac) systems.
- Provides commands for status readouts, equipment control, aux circuits, lighting effects, and chlorinator adjustments.
- Handles command confirmations, state verification, and common troubleshooting (offline systems, credential errors, rate limiting).
- Designed for natural language queries about pool or spa conditions and controls.
